The following script includes analysis for XX.

Beverly Fu

```{r Standard Setup}
# Configure directories, load libraries and base functions
source(paste0(here::here(), "/0-config.R"))

directory = paste0(here(), "/3-figures/")

sample_file_path <- paste0(here(), "/1-data/Weeklong-exercise-study.xlsx")

ex_summary <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 1)
ex_parameters <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 2)
subj_01 <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 3)
subj_08 <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 4)
subj_11 <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 5)
subj_12 <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 6)
subj_19 <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 7)
subj_20 <- read_excel(sample_file_path, sheet = 8)

subject_list <- list(
  "01" = subj_01,
  "08" = subj_08,
  "11" = subj_11,
  "12" = subj_12,
  "19" = subj_19,
  "20" = subj_20
)

ex_summary_lf <- ex_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Subject_ID,
    names_to = "Column_name",
    values_to = "Value") %>% 
  left_join(ex_parameters, by = "Column_name") %>%
  mutate(Period = factor(Period, levels = c("Pre", "Post", "Delta"))) %>%
  mutate(Cooling = factor(Cooling, levels = c("No cooling", "Cooling")))
```

#######################################
# Summary
#######################################

```{r Exercise summary}
df <- ex_summary_lf %>%
  filter(Period %in% c("Pre", "Post"))

g <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Period, y = Value, group = Subject_ID, color = Subject_ID)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  facet_nested(rows = vars(Parameter, Unit), cols = vars(Cooling), scales = "free_y") + 
  theme(coord_fixed()) + 
  theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Exercise/Exercise-summary.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 4, height = 4)
```

```{r Exercise summary delta}
df <- ex_summary_lf %>%
  filter(Period %in% c("Delta"))

g <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Cooling2, y = Value, fill = Subject_ID)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  facet_nested(rows = vars(Parameter, Unit), cols = vars(Subject_ID), scales = "free_y") + 
  labs(x = "Cooling") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  theme_custom_text()

ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Exercise/Exercise-summary-delta.pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 4 , height = 4)
```

#######################################
# Line plots
#######################################

```{r Exercise summary delta}

for (sid in names(subject_list)) {
  
  # Get the dataframe
  df <- subject_list[[sid]]
  
  # Reshape to long format
  df_long <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Temp_C_NC, HR_NC, Temp_C_C, HR_C),
                 names_to = "Variable",
                 values_to = "Value") %>%
      mutate(Cooling = if_else(str_detect(Variable, "_NC$"), "No cooling", "Cooling"),
             Parameter = case_when(
             str_starts(Variable, "Temp") ~ "Temperature (°C)",
             str_starts(Variable, "HR") ~ "Heart Rate (bpm)")) %>% 
    mutate(Cooling = factor(Cooling, levels = c("No cooling", "Cooling")))
  
  # Create plot
  g <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Time_min, y = Value, color = Parameter)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(df_long$Time_min, na.rm = TRUE), by = 10)) +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(Cooling)) + #scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Time (min)") +
    theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    theme_custom_text()
  
  ggsave(paste0(directory, "/Weeklong-Exercise/Individual-plots/Exercise-", sid, ".pdf"), plot = g, device = "pdf", width = 4 , height = 4)
}

```
